Uttar Pradesh UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh UP Scholarship Online Form 2026-27. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official portal before the closing date. Review all important dates, fee requirements, and eligibility below. Important: 15 October 2026 is the deadline.

Important Dates

  • Application Start : 22 July 2026
  • Registration Last Date : 15 October 2026
  • Last Date For Form Complete : 31 October 2026
  • Last Date For Submission of Hard Copy To College : As per Schedule
  • Correction Date : As per Schedule

Application Fee

  • No Fee

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
